description: Supported-environment matrix for automatic browser handoff. Only `proven` entries may enable automatic opening, and only on an exact match of every field in lib/profile.mjs MATCH_FIELDS. Every other environment prints the manual local URL.

profiles.note: Conventional handoff: the fragment URL is opener argv. The cross-user observer read the credential from both xdg-open's and the browser's /proc/<pid>/cmdline in every negative-control trial. Never supported.

The operator's own default handler (for example `/usr/bin/chromium %U`) in a visible session. Same opener and handoff path, but not run here because it would open a window on the operator's desktop. Prove with run.mjs --exec '<exec with {profile}>'.
xdg-open delegating to gio, kde-open, exo-open or similar when XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP names a known desktop. The adapter forces X-Generic instead of claiming these.
hidepid=invisible or noaccess hides other users' processes, which is stricter but was not the tested visibility control.
